cat > build_mol.py <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
# Construct the fused conjugated core using the Kekule bond orders visible in the drawing.
rw = Chem.RWMol()
labels = ['A','B','C','D','E','F','G','H','nL','J','K','L','M','P','Q','nR','T','U','V','W','ClL','ClR',
          'C1','C2','C3','C4','C5','O5','C6','O2','O3','O4','O6']
idx={}
for name in labels:
    el = 'Cl' if name.startswith('Cl') else ('N' if name.startswith('n') else ('O' if name.startswith('O') else 'C'))
    a=Chem.Atom(el)
    if name=='nR': a.SetNoImplicit(True)
    idx[name]=rw.AddAtom(a)

def addbond(u,v,typ=Chem.BondType.SINGLE):
    rw.AddBond(idx[u],idx[v],typ)

rings=[['A','B','C','D','E','F'],
       ['C','G','H','nL','D'],
       ['G','J','K','L','M','H'],
       ['L','P','Q','nR','M'],
       ['P','T','U','V','W','Q']]
doubles={tuple(sorted(e)) for e in [('A','B'),('C','D'),('E','F'),('G','H'),('J','K'),('L','M'),('P','Q'),('T','U'),('V','W')]}
seen=set()
for ring in rings:
    for u,v in zip(ring,ring[1:]+ring[:1]):
        e=tuple(sorted((u,v)))
        if e not in seen:
            addbond(u,v,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE if e in doubles else Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
            seen.add(e)
# chlorines and the N-glycosidic sugar
for u,v in [('A','ClL'),('U','ClR'),('nR','C1'),
            ('C1','C2'),('C2','C3'),('C3','C4'),('C4','C5'),('C5','O5'),('O5','C1'),
            ('C5','C6'),('C2','O2'),('C3','O3'),('C4','O4'),('C6','O6')]:
    addbond(u,v)
m=rw.GetMol()
Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
# The indicated wedges/dashes define these configurations; anomeric C1 and C5 are unmarked.
target={'C2':'R','C3':'S','C4':'R'}
for name in target:
    m.GetAtomWithIdx(idx[name]).SetChiralTag(Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CCW)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
for name,code in target.items():
    a=m.GetAtomWithIdx(idx[name])
    got=a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else None
    if got != code:
        a.SetChiralTag(Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CW)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
print('stereochemistry',[(n,m.GetAtomWithIdx(idx[n]).GetProp('_CIPCode')) for n in target])
print('heavy atoms',m.GetNumAtoms(),'SMILES',Chem.MolToSmiles(m))
m=Chem.AddHs(m)
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=146; params.numThreads=1
res=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,params)
if res<0: raise RuntimeError('ETKDG embedding failed')
props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(m)
if props is None: raise RuntimeError('MMFF parameterization failed')
status=AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m,mmffVariant='MMFF94s',maxIters=1500)
print('MMFF status',status,'total atoms',m.GetNumAtoms())
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
print('final stereochemistry',[(n,m.GetAtomWithIdx(idx[n]).GetProp('_CIPCode')) for n in target])
conf=m.GetConformer()
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
    f.write(f'{m.GetNumAtoms()}\n')
    f.write('3D structure generated from mol_0146.png\n')
    for i,a in enumerate(m.GetAtoms()):
        p=conf.GetAtomPosition(i)
        f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol():2s} {p.x: .8f} {p.y: .8f} {p.z: .8f}\n')
